family_policy: Collapse exact duplicate sequences first. Edge-frame collapse then keeps one representative per same length, first sign, and last sign frame, except length <= 2 stays exact. One-edit-family collapse unions exact-collapsed sequences sharing a one-position wildcard frame or a one-token deletion frame, then keeps one representative per family.
representative_policy: Representatives are chosen deterministically by highest exact-sequence duplicate weight, then lowest local id. This is a downweighting stress test, not an epigraphic replacement for the excluded rows.
interpretation_boundary: Formula-family downweighting T3 structural scout only; stored-order and masked-sign results are not sign values, semantics, phonetics, or translations.
